articles.title: Explosive Growth of Drone Technology in Oil & Gas is The Next Wave of Expansion Happening from The Sky
articles.summary: Autonomous aerial surveying is becoming a critical tool for energy companies, driving significant enhancements in operational efficiency and cost reduction. This technological advancement allows businesses to streamline complex data collection, improve accuracy, and optimize resource deployment. Such automation is transforming surveying processes, enabling the energy sector to achieve more sustainable and economical operations crucial for future growth.

articles.title: Maruti Suzuki gears up for EV push, ramps up its Gujarat facility
articles.summary: India's largest carmaker, Maruti Suzuki India Ltd, has commenced production at a new manufacturing plant in its Gujarat facility. This strategic move aims to significantly step up the company's electric vehicle (EV) manufacturing capabilities, addressing existing capacity limitations. It marks a crucial development in India's automotive sector as the nation pushes towards greater EV adoption and domestic production.

articles.title: Raengdai Begins Durand Cup Journey With Victory
articles.summary: FC Raengdai made a historic Durand Cup debut, securing a 1-0 victory against the Indian Navy Football Team. Khaidem Amarjit Singh scored the decisive goal. This significant win not only marks a memorable moment in the tournament but also underscores the Indian Armed Forces' active and spirited participation in national sporting events like the prestigious Durand Cup, showcasing their versatile capabilities beyond conventional duties.

articles.title: The ePlane Company strengthens its supply chain and strategic partnerships at Farnborough International Airshow 2026
articles.summary: The ePlane Company (Ubifly Technologies), an Indian startup developing electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft, announced strategic partnerships at the Farnborough International Airshow in the UK. These collaborations aim to accelerate the development and deployment of their innovative air taxi solutions, signifying a notable advancement in sustainable urban air mobility.

articles.title: Study moots phased time-bound reduction of import duty on aluminium to zero
articles.summary: A report by the Policy Consensus Centre recommends a phased, time-bound reduction to zero of the basic customs duty on primary aluminium. This policy transformation aims to impact the domestic aluminium sector by potentially lowering raw material costs for manufacturers, enhancing competitiveness, and fostering industrial growth. Such economic policy changes are crucial for national development and industry support.

articles.title: W.A. Chester Awarded Major High-Pressure Fluid-Filled Transmission Infrastructure Project
articles.summary: A new transmission feeder is being deployed in Miami Beach, Florida, to significantly enhance the regional power grid's long-term reliability and system resiliency. This critical infrastructure upgrade is vital for supporting future power demand, ensuring a stable electricity supply for the region. Such projects underscore the importance of robust energy infrastructure for national stability and progress.

articles.title: GH Power and TKMS Continue to Explore Clean Energy Collaboration in Support of Canada’s Future Patrol Submarine Project
articles.summary: GH Power, a Canadian clean energy technology firm, innovates modular reactor systems. These systems efficiently convert recycled metals and water into high-purity alumina and clean hydrogen. This technology presents a significant advancement in sustainable resource management and clean energy production, aligning with global efforts towards a greener future.

articles.title: DELIVERY OF SECOND INDIGENOUS DIVING SUPPORT VESSEL - 'NIPUN'
articles.summary: India's indigenous defence capabilities received a significant boost with the delivery of 'Nipun', the second Diving Support Vessel (DSV). Built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited, this crucial vessel enhances the Indian Navy's capacity for underwater operations, maintenance, and strategic support for sub-surface assets. It signifies a stride towards maritime self-reliance and strengthens India's naval presence.

articles.title: cidx added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new zero-config local code index is introduced for AI coding agents, featuring an optional, reproducible evaluation harness. This tool allows users to independently measure retrieval tools, enhancing the performance and reliability of AI agents through standardized assessment. The project is currently v1 feature-complete, providing a robust solution for developers and researchers working with AI-powered coding.
